mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, total_price, payment_status, status FROM orders WHERE id = #{order_id} LIMIT 1

SELECT ut.id AS subscription_id, ut.user_id, ut.tariff_plan_id AS tariff_id, ut.status AS subscription_status, tp.name AS tariff_name, tp.monthly_price AS price, tp.duration_months AS duration_month, fm.mxik_code AS fiscal_mxik_code, fmp.package_code AS fiscal_package_code, tp.vat_percent FROM user_tariffs ut INNER JOIN tariff_plans tp ON tp.id = ut.tariff_plan_id LEFT JOIN fiscal_mxik_package fmp ON fmp.id = tp.fiscal_mxik_package_id LEFT JOIN fiscal_mxik fm ON fm.id = fmp.mxik_id WHERE ut.id = #{subscription_id} AND tp.is_active = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT id AS order_item_id, product_name, unit_price, quantity, fiscal_mxik_code, fiscal_package_code, vat_percent FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{order_id} ORDER BY id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payments ( order_id, user_id, payment_type, user_tariff_id, provider, provider_transaction_id, amount, amount_tiyin, status, payme_time, payme_create_time ) VALUES ( #{order_id}, #{user_id}, CASE WHEN #{subscription_id} IS NULL THEN 'ORDER' ELSE 'TARIFF' END, #{subscription_id}, 'PAYME', #{provider_transaction_id}, #{amount}, #{amount_tiyin}, 'CREATED', #{payme_time}, #{payme_create_time} )
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, p.user_tariff_id AS subscription_id FROM payments p WHERE p.provider = 'PAYME' AND p.provider_transaction_id = #{transaction_id} LIMIT 1

SELECT p.*, p.user_tariff_id AS subscription_id FROM payments p WHERE p.user_tariff_id = #{subscription_id} AND p.payment_type = 'TARIFF' AND p.provider = 'PAYME' AND p.status IN ('CREATED', 'PENDING', 'PAID') ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET payment_status = #{payment_status}, status = CASE WHEN #{payment_status} = 'PAID' AND status = 'PENDING' THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE status END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{order_id}

UPDATE user_tariffs SET status = #{subscription_status}, cancelled_at = CASE WHEN #{subscription_status} = 'CANCELLED' THEN NOW() ELSE cancelled_at END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{subscription_id}

UPDATE user_tariffs current_tariff INNER JOIN user_tariffs new_tariff ON new_tariff.id = #{subscription_id} AND current_tariff.user_id = new_tariff.user_id SET current_tariff.status = 'EXPIRED', current_tariff.end_date = NOW(), current_tariff.updated_at = NOW() WHERE current_tariff.id <> new_tariff.id AND current_tariff.status = 'ACTIVE'

UPDATE user_tariffs ut INNER JOIN tariff_plans tp ON tp.id = ut.tariff_plan_id SET ut.status = 'ACTIVE', ut.start_date = NOW(), ut.end_date = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL tp.duration_months MONTH), ut.activated_at = NOW(), ut.cancelled_at = NULL, ut.updated_at = NOW() WHERE ut.id = #{subscription_id} AND ut.status = 'PENDING' AND tp.is_active = 1
UPDATE payments SET status = 'PAID', payme_perform_time = #{payme_perform_time}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE provider = 'PAYME' AND provider_transaction_id = #{transaction_id} AND status = 'CREATED'
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, p.user_tariff_id AS subscription_id FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = #{order_id} AND p.payment_type = 'ORDER' AND p.provider = 'PAYME' AND p.status IN ('CREATED', 'PENDING', 'PAID') ORDER BY p.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE payments SET status = #{status}, payme_cancel_time = #{payme_cancel_time}, payme_reason = #{payme_reason}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE provider = 'PAYME' AND provider_transaction_id = #{transaction_id} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'PAID')
mapper.select: SELECT provider_transaction_id AS id, payme_time AS time, amount_tiyin AS amount, payme_create_time AS create_time, payme_perform_time AS perform_time, payme_cancel_time AS cancel_time, provider_transaction_id AS transaction, payme_reason AS reason, status, order_id, user_tariff_id AS subscription_id FROM payments WHERE payme_create_time BETWEEN #{from_time} AND #{to_time} ORDER BY payme_create_time ASC
